pli-tv-bu-vb-sk57:1.2: tena kho pana samayena chabbaggiyā bhikkhū chattapāṇissa dhammaṃ desenti.
pli-tv-bu-vb-sk57:1.3: ye te bhikkhū appicchā …pe… te ujjhāyanti khīyanti vipācenti.
pli-tv-bu-vb-sk57:1.4: “kathaṃ hi nāma chabbaggiyā bhikkhū chattapāṇissa dhammaṃ desessantī”ti …pe…
pli-tv-bu-vb-sk57:1.5: saccaṃ kira tumhe bhikkhave chattapāṇissa dhammaṃ desethāti.
pli-tv-bu-vb-sk57:1.8: kathaṃ hi nāma tumhe moghapurisā chattapāṇissa dhammaṃ desessatha.
pli-tv-bu-vb-sk57:1.10: evañca pana bhikkhave imaṃ sikkhāpadaṃ uddiseyyātha:
pli-tv-bu-vb-sk57:1.11.1: na chattapāṇissa dhammaṃ desissāmīti sikkhā karaṇīyā’ti.
pli-tv-bu-vb-sk57:1.12: evañcidaṃ bhagavatā bhikkhūnaṃ sikkhāpadaṃ paññattaṃ hoti.
pli-tv-bu-vb-sk57:2.1: tena kho pana samayena bhikkhū chattapāṇissa gilānassa dhammaṃ desetuṃ kukkuccāyantā na desenti.
pli-tv-bu-vb-sk57:2.3: “kathaṃ hi nāma samaṇā sakyaputtiyā chattapāṇissa gilānassa dhammaṃ na desessantī”ti.
pli-tv-bu-vb-sk57:2.4: assosuṃ kho bhikkhū tesaṃ manussānaṃ ujjhāyantānaṃ khīyantānaṃ vipācentānaṃ.
pli-tv-bu-vb-sk57:2.5: atha kho te bhikkhū bhagavato etamatthaṃ ārocesuṃ.
pli-tv-bu-vb-sk57:2.6: atha kho bhagavā etasmiṃ nidāne etasmiṃ pakaraṇe dhammiṃ kathaṃ katvā bhikkhū āmantesi
pli-tv-bu-vb-sk57:2.8: evañca pana bhikkhave imaṃ sikkhāpadaṃ uddiseyyātha:
pli-tv-bu-vb-sk57:2.9.1: na chattapāṇissa agilānassa dhammaṃ desissāmīti sikkhā karaṇīyā’ti.
pli-tv-bu-vb-sk57:2.11: tīṇi chattāni setacchattaṃ kilañjacchattaṃ paṇṇacchattaṃ maṇḍala baddhaṃ salākabaddhaṃ.
pli-tv-bu-vb-sk57:2.13: buddhabhāsito sāvakabhāsito isibhāsito devatābhāsito atthūpasañhito dhammūpasaṃhito.
pli-tv-bu-vb-sk57:2.15: padena deseti pade pade āpatti dukkaṭassa.
pli-tv-bu-vb-sk57:2.18: yo anādariyaṃ paṭicca chattapāṇissa agilānassa dhammaṃ deseti āpatti dukkaṭassa.
